{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Display the first few rows
print(sales_df.head().to_string())

# Display basic info
print('\nData info:')
print(sales_df.info())

# Check for missing values
missing_values = sales_df.isnull().sum()
print('\nMissing values:')
print(missing_values.to_string())

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = sales_df.duplicated().sum()
print(f'\nDuplicate rows: {duplicates}')

# Display unique values for key columns
print('\nUnique values in campaign column:')
print(sales_df['campaign'].unique())

print('\nUnique values in date column (first 10):')
print(sales_df['date'].unique()[:10])

# Check the dictionary for definitions
dict_df = pd.read_md('data/sales_dictionary.md')
print('\nDictionary content:')
print(dict_df.to_string())"}
